papers.title: Gaussian Processes and Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces: Connections and Equivalences
authors: Motonobu Kanagawa, Philipp Hennig, Dino Sejdinovic, Bharath K. Sriperumbudur
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2506.17366v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: This monograph studies the relations between two approaches using positive definite kernels: probabilistic methods using Gaussian processes, and non-probabilistic methods using reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHS). They are widely studied and used in machine learning, statistics, and numerical analysis. We study connections and equivalences for fundamental topics such as regression, interpolation, numerical integration, distributional discrepancies, and statistical dependence, as well as sample path properties of Gaussian processes.
